company_branch_event_status.name: company_branch_event_status
company_branch_event_status.value: ("company_branch_events"."from_status" is null or "company_branch_events"."from_status" in ('PENDING_REGISTRATION','ACTIVE','REJECTED','CLOSED')) and "company_branch_events"."to_status" in ('PENDING_REGISTRATION','ACTIVE','REJECTED','CLOSED')

company_share_event_source.name: company_share_event_source
company_share_event_source.value:
("company_share_events"."kind" = 'INITIAL' and "company_share_events"."application_id" is not null and "company_share_events"."decision_id" is null and "company_share_events"."from_subject_id" is null and "company_share_events"."to_subject_id" is null) or
    ("company_share_events"."kind" = 'ISSUE' and "company_share_events"."decision_id" is not null and "company_share_events"."application_id" is null and "company_share_events"."from_subject_id" is null and "company_share_events"."to_subject_id" is null) or
    ("company_share_events"."kind" = 'TRANSFER' and "company_share_events"."application_id" is null and "company_share_events"."from_subject_id" is not null and "company_share_events"."to_subject_id" is not null and "company_share_events"."from_subject_id" <> "company_share_events"."to_subject_id")

fx_exchange_context.name: fx_exchange_context
fx_exchange_context.value: "fx_exchanges"."event" = 'FX_EXCHANGE' and "fx_exchanges"."receive_currency_id" <> "fx_exchanges"."provide_currency_id" and "fx_exchanges"."receive_minor" > 0 and "fx_exchanges"."provide_minor" > 0 and (("fx_exchanges"."offer_id" is not null and "fx_exchanges"."quote_id" is not null and "fx_exchanges"."trade_id" is null) or ("fx_exchanges"."offer_id" is null and "fx_exchanges"."quote_id" is null and "fx_exchanges"."trade_id" is not null))

legal_subject_identity.name: legal_subject_identity
legal_subject_identity.value:
num_nonnulls("legal_subjects"."player_id", "legal_subjects"."state_id", "legal_subjects"."company_id") = 1 and (
    ("legal_subjects"."kind" = 'PLAYER' and "legal_subjects"."player_id" is not null and "legal_subjects"."id" = "legal_subjects"."player_id") or
    ("legal_subjects"."kind" = 'STATE' and "legal_subjects"."state_id" is not null and "legal_subjects"."id" = "legal_subjects"."state_id") or
    ("legal_subjects"."kind" = 'COMPANY' and "legal_subjects"."company_id" is not null and "legal_subjects"."id" = "legal_subjects"."company_id"))

territory_draft_seal.name: territory_draft_seal
territory_draft_seal.value: ("territory_drafts"."sealed_at" is null and "territory_drafts"."hash" is null) or ("territory_drafts"."sealed_at" is not null and "territory_drafts"."hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "territory_drafts"."geometry" is not null)

territory_revision_valid.name: territory_revision_valid
territory_revision_valid.value: ST_IsValid("territory_revisions"."geom") and not ST_IsEmpty("territory_revisions"."geom") and ST_NPoints("territory_revisions"."geom") <= 4096 and ST_Area("territory_revisions"."geom") > 0 and ST_Area("territory_revisions"."geom") <= 1000000000 and "territory_revisions"."area" = ST_Area("territory_revisions"."geom")

voting_voter_identity.name: voting_voter_identity
